nodes.label: Ticket review STATUS (REPRODUCED / NOT REPRODUCED / BLOCKED / PARTIAL)
nodes.norm_label: ticket review status (reproduced / not reproduced / blocked / partial)

nodes.label: Run state (tmp/team/<spec slug>/)
nodes.rationale: One folder per spec so specs never read each other's state.

nodes.label: Auto mode permissions
nodes.rationale: Auto mode blocks force pushes, so workflow merges base instead of rebasing.

nodes.label: Git allow rules (commit, merge, push feature/*)
nodes.norm_label: git allow rules (commit, merge, push feature/*)
nodes.rationale: Auto mode blocked engineers' git commit in the Nov 9 team-mode run.

nodes.label: Auto-allow exemptions (AskUserQuestion, ExitPlanMode, deny rules, org ask ceilings)
nodes.norm_label: auto-allow exemptions (askuserquestion, exitplanmode, deny rules, org ask ceilings)
nodes.rationale: Workflow questions and plan approval are decisions, not permission asks; deny rules and org ceilings outrank bypass.

nodes.label: Per-tool-call permission mode tracking
nodes.rationale: Plugin previously only noticed mode changes at the next prompt.

nodes.label: Single hooks module rule ($ passed only to module-level functions)
nodes.norm_label: single hooks module rule ($ passed only to module-level functions)

nodes.label: Team mode spec
nodes.rationale: Per-task flow cost $15.19/58 min vs prototype $4.90/12 min; lead routing and per-task review/QA dominate cost.

nodes.label: Never skip code-reviewer or qa-tester
nodes.rationale: Self-reports are not review, unit tests are not QA, small diffs still break contracts.

nodes.label: Team mode (default orchestrator flow)
nodes.rationale: Measured on the todo spec: per-task flow $15.19/58 min vs team-mode prototype ~$4.90/12 min.

nodes.label: Bundled skills (tdd, surgical-patch, safe-refactor, writing-for-agents, handoff)
nodes.norm_label: bundled skills (tdd, surgical-patch, safe-refactor, writing-for-agents, handoff)

nodes.label: Skill preloading doesn't reach teammates
nodes.rationale: Claude Code doesn't apply skills: frontmatter to agent-team teammates, so Skill tool was restored on engineers, qa-tester, ticket-reviewer.

nodes.label: Edit/Write only, never patch source via Bash
nodes.norm_label: edit/write only, never patch source via bash
nodes.rationale: Bash writes re-send whole files and hide the diff from the approval pane.

nodes.label: TDD iron law (no production code without failing test)
nodes.norm_label: tdd iron law (no production code without failing test)

nodes.label: Eval: orchestrator stops without acceptance criteria
nodes.norm_label: eval: orchestrator stops without acceptance criteria

nodes.label: Task sizing: one behavior per task
nodes.norm_label: task sizing: one behavior per task
nodes.rationale: 'As small as it can be' multiplies ~$7.60 per task; option 1 kept backend/frontend roles; full-stack option deferred.

nodes.label: Fix plan decisions (usage thresholds, Linear closing, Jev opt-in, GitButler exception, task sizing)
nodes.norm_label: fix plan decisions (usage thresholds, linear closing, jev opt-in, gitbutler exception, task sizing)

nodes.label: Gate routes blockers directly to engineers via SendMessage
nodes.norm_label: gate routes blockers directly to engineers via sendmessage

nodes.label: Finding severity: BLOCKER vs NOTE
nodes.rationale: Only blockers cause another round; notes go to the feature PR (audit Flaw 6).

nodes.label: Stop processes only by saved PID
nodes.norm_label: stop processes only by saved pid
nodes.rationale: pkill -f matches other agents' servers and auto mode denies it.

nodes.label: Final gate
nodes.rationale: Each task was only reviewed/tested alone; final gate checks merged feature branch against every AC.

nodes.label: Audit skill (Tech Debt Audit)
nodes.rationale: Not diplomatic; cite file:line for every finding; read code before judging.

nodes.label: Safe Refactor OpenAI agent interface config
nodes.norm_label: safe refactor openai agent interface config

nodes.label: AC12: disabled control while saving, inline save error
nodes.norm_label: ac12: disabled control while saving, inline save error

nodes.label: Final gate: merged result review and QA
nodes.norm_label: final gate: merged result review and qa

nodes.label: OPTIONAL git-allow permission rules
nodes.rationale: Auto mode blocks an agent's git commit without an allow rule.

nodes.label: Plugin task gate (project checks per task)
nodes.norm_label: plugin task gate (project checks per task)

nodes.label: Eval: orchestrator stops without acceptance criteria (prompt)
nodes.norm_label: eval: orchestrator stops without acceptance criteria (prompt)

nodes.label: Eval case: reviewer catches cleared-error refailure
nodes.norm_label: eval case: reviewer catches cleared-error refailure

nodes.label: Intent T4: Clear save errors on any successful action
nodes.norm_label: intent t4: clear save errors on any successful action

nodes.label: Eval prompt: dispatch code-reviewer with orchestrator brief
nodes.norm_label: eval prompt: dispatch code-reviewer with orchestrator brief

nodes.label: .jev-enabled opt-in
nodes.rationale: Script sends whole diff/spec to TypeSafe without secret scrubbing, so repo owner must opt in.

nodes.label: LLM strategy (local Ollama vs production)
nodes.rationale: Local dev/QA never calls real external services or LLMs; strategy split is required, not speculative.

nodes.label: Usage limit: stop spawning at 90%, pause at 95%
nodes.norm_label: usage limit: stop spawning at 90%, pause at 95%

nodes.label: SDK-style interfaces over generic fetchers
nodes.rationale: Each mock returns one shape, no conditional logic in test setup, type safety per endpoint

nodes.label: Red-green loop
nodes.rationale: Refactoring is not part of the loop; it belongs to code review

nodes.label: Seam (public test boundary)
nodes.rationale: Test only at pre-agreed seams confirmed with the user so effort lands on critical paths

nodes.label: Vertical slices / tracer bullets
nodes.rationale: Horizontal slicing tests imagined behavior and commits to test structure too early

nodes.label: Context pointer
nodes.rationale: Pointer wording, not its target, decides when and how reliably the agent reaches material

nodes.label: Information hierarchy (in-file step, in-file reference, disclosed reference)
nodes.norm_label: information hierarchy (in-file step, in-file reference, disclosed reference)

nodes.label: Model-invoked vs user-invoked skill
nodes.rationale: Model invocation costs permanent context load for discoverability; user invocation costs cognitive load

nodes.label: Router skill
nodes.rationale: Cures piled-up cognitive load of many user-invoked skills

nodes.label: Progressive disclosure
nodes.rationale: Protects the hierarchy; inline what every branch needs, disclose what only some branches reach

nodes.label: Writing for Agents OpenAI agent config
nodes.norm_label: writing for agents openai agent config

nodes.label: Narrowest responsible layer fix
nodes.rationale: Change only the layer owning incorrect behavior; preserve unrelated behavior; add only relevant regression proof

nodes.label: Task doc (intent file or Linear issue)
nodes.norm_label: task doc (intent file or linear issue)

nodes.label: jev.sh spec-check
nodes.rationale: Jev flags are hints, not vetoes; the user decides

nodes.label: Agent teams settings (CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS, CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS)
nodes.rationale: Without TODO tools newer models get no TaskCreate so team mode cannot use the shared task list

nodes.label: Git permissions allowlist (commit, merge, push to feature/*)
nodes.norm_label: git permissions allowlist (commit, merge, push to feature/*)
nodes.rationale: Lets engineers commit and push only to feature/ branches; force pushes stay blocked

nodes.label: Scoping from an audit (TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md)
nodes.rationale: One spec holds one type because /orchestrator gates BUG specs on ticket-reviewer

nodes.label: Spec template (Type, Tech stack, ACs, Scope)
nodes.norm_label: spec template (type, tech stack, acs, scope)

nodes.label: Reset count button for corrupt count file
nodes.norm_label: reset count button for corrupt count file

nodes.label: Pomodoro ring (pomodoro-ring.wav, make-ring.ts)
nodes.rationale: Generated so it can ship under MIT; played via afplay, macOS only

nodes.label: Today's count (pomodoroDay cross-session store)
nodes.rationale: Shared by all sessions; date mismatch reads as 0 so count resets at local midnight

nodes.label: API keys never typed into conversation (LINEAR_API_KEY, TYPESAFE_API_KEY)
nodes.norm_label: api keys never typed into conversation (linear_api_key, typesafe_api_key)

nodes.label: One multiple-choice question per turn via AskUserQuestion
nodes.norm_label: one multiple-choice question per turn via askuserquestion

nodes.label: Known limits (loose plugins/store check, Windows paths, non-atomic store)
nodes.norm_label: known limits (loose plugins/store check, windows paths, non-atomic store)

nodes.label: CI lint: no working-directory script paths
nodes.norm_label: ci lint: no working-directory script paths
nodes.rationale: Prompts must use ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR} so script paths resolve (audit Flaw 3).

nodes.label: CI lint: per-spec run state paths
nodes.norm_label: ci lint: per-spec run state paths
nodes.rationale: Run state lives in tmp/team/<spec slug>/ (audit Flaw 1).

nodes.label: CI script tests (jev, linear, cleanup, status, check)
nodes.norm_label: ci script tests (jev, linear, cleanup, status, check)

nodes.label: Flaw 1: leftover state hijacks new specs
nodes.norm_label: flaw 1: leftover state hijacks new specs

nodes.label: Flaw 2: nothing tests the merged result
nodes.norm_label: flaw 2: nothing tests the merged result

nodes.label: Flaw 4: QA can pass with an AC untested
nodes.norm_label: flaw 4: qa can pass with an ac untested

nodes.label: QA BLOCKED verdict for untested ACs
nodes.norm_label: qa blocked verdict for untested acs

nodes.label: Jev advisory signals
nodes.rationale: Jev only sees text sent to it and is uncalibrated, so it is advisory and never a gate.
